name: calc_tan_ge_cubic
statement: (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < Real.pi / 2) : x + x ^ 3 / 3 ≤ Real.tan x
closed: ∀ (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x < Real.pi / 2), x + x ^ 3 / 3 ≤ Real.tan x
informal: tan x ≥ x + x³/3 on [0, π/2) — derivative of tan x − x − x³/3 is tan²x − x² ≥ 0 since tan x ≥ x (Real.lt_tan); monotonicity on [0,π/2).
type: ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → x < Real.pi / 2 → x + x ^ 3 / 3 ≤ Real.tan x
